1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One sodium concentration pair, wide bands and numeric feedback. Manual ±1 calibration is available; one pump must complete three crossings, followed by a six-tick target hold. No leak is required.
1.natural_language: Establish the sodium target bands. Place the ATP pump, drag ATP into the fuel well, and wait until the bars settle inside the highlighted bands. Keep every bar inside its target band for 6 transport ticks, then lock the gradient. The membrane continues to update while you observe it. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Two concentration pairs share ATP and one selective leak must be observed and removed. Numeric feedback and manual ±1 calibration permit final count correction; both bands must hold for six ticks.
2.natural_language: Establish both target gradients. Use the visible protein briefs, observe one passive leak crossing, eject that leak, then fuel both ATP pumps. Keep every bar inside its highlighted target band for 6 transport ticks before locking. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.

3.label: medium
3.summary: The L3 baseline has two solutes, narrower bands and faster transport than L2, with an observed-and-removed leak. Numeric feedback and manual ±1 calibration remain available, so precise pump stopping is not required. Four pump crossings and a six-tick hold are completion rules, not evidence of harder planning.
3.natural_language: Gate the membrane. Place the required selective leak, watch a passive crossing, and eject it. Then place and fuel the sodium and potassium ATP pumps until both concentration pairs enter their target bands. Keep every bar inside its target band for 6 transport ticks, then lock. Use only screenshots and visible task controls in this webpage; do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload/navigation, extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Three concentration pairs share ATP, two leaks must be observed and removed, and the catalog includes two explicitly inactive proteins. Five crossings per pump and a six-tick hold are required. Numeric feedback and manual ±1 calibration permit final correction without precise pump stopping.
4.natural_language: Establish all three target gradients. Place each required transporter, observe and eject both passive leak probes before the final lock, then fuel all three ATP pumps. Read the moving bars and visible crossing ledger, keep every target band occupied for 6 transport ticks, and then lock. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Three concentration pairs use bar-only current-count feedback and the narrowest target bands. Manual ±1 calibration still permits recovery after transport stops; no sustained timing precision is required. Six crossings per pump, two observed-and-removed leaks and a six-tick hold remain completion rules.
5.natural_language: Establish all three target gradients. Use the membrane as a live experiment: observe both selective leaks, remove them, fuel the three pumps in measured bursts, and hold every bar in its narrow target band for 6 transport ticks before locking. Only the visible task webpage and its controls are allowed; forbid code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, and unrelated tabs.

simplified.summary: Choose a visible membrane slot, then click PLACE; use EJECT, +/− solute, and SUPPLY ATP BURST controls. Each proxy records the same transporter, slot, burst-size, solute, and resource effect as its full-input counterpart.

full.summary: Drag protein cards into a chosen membrane slot, drag an installed protein to the eject dock, drag solute tokens into either compartment, and drag ATP bursts into the fuel well.
